facts.tagline: Matcha bar on Shattuck Avenue in downtown Berkeley: matcha and hojicha drinks made with your choice of matcha, plus crepes on weekends.
facts.contactOnly: Yume Mori publishes no menu or prices outside the shop; their drinks and crepes are ordered at the counter. Email yumemori.berkeley@gmail.com or visit 2319 Shattuck Ave.
